title: OPEN TEXT CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Open Text Corporation filed an 8-K announcing executive leadership changes effective April 20, 2026: James McGourlay transitioned from Interim CEO to President and Chief Client Officer, while Paul Duggan stepped down as President and Chief Customer Officer but will remain as Executive Vice President and Special Advisor until his departure on July 1, 2026.
key_points: Open Text Corporation (ticker: OTEX) is listed on NASDAQ Global Select Market
James McGourlay transitioned from Interim CEO to President, Chief Client Officer effective April 20, 2026
Paul Duggan stepped down as President, Chief Customer Officer effective April 20, 2026
Paul Duggan will continue as Executive Vice President, Special Advisor until July 1, 2026
Michael F. Acedo signed the filing as EVP, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
The filing includes a press release (Exhibit 99.1) announcing the appointments
